<infobox type="character">
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>
    <panel name="img">
        <section name="section1">
            <label>{{{skin1|Original Skin}}}</label>
			<image source="image1">
				  <default>{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} (Pose).png|{{PAGENAME}} (Pose).png|{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|Non_Evo_Name}} (Pose).png}}</default>
				  <caption source="caption1"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section2">
            <label>{{{skin2|Shiny Skin}}}</label>
				<image source="image2">
					<default>{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|Non_Evo_Name}} Shiny (Pose).png}}</default>
					<caption source="caption2"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section3">
            <label>{{{skin3}}}</label>
				<image source="image3">
					<caption source="caption3"/>
				</image>
        </section>
   </panel>
  <data source="deployment_cost">
    <label>Deployment Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{deployment_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum: {{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|cost}}}}¥</span>|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="total_cost">
    <label>Total Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{total_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|total_cost}}}}¥</span>|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="upgrade_levels">
    <label>Upgrade Levels</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade_levels}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
    <data source="spawn_cap">
    <label>Spawn Cap</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|spawn_cap}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Tower_type">
    <label>Tower Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|tower_type}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Damage_type">
  	<label>Damage Type</label>
  	<default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|base_damage_type}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Secondary_Damage_type">
  	<label>Secondary Damage Type</label>
  	<default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|secondary_damage_types}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
  </data>
  <group>
    <header>Attack Stats</header>
    <data source="Crit_Chance">
      <label>Crit Chance</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|crit_chance}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="Attack_Type">
      <label>Attack Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|attack_type}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="damage">
		<label>Damage</label>
		<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|damage}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|damage}}|{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|damage|max}}||-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|damage|max}} }}}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="seconds_per_attack">
      <label>Attack Rate</label>
      <default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|attack_cooldown}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|attack_cooldown}}|{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}}||-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}} }}}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="range">
    	<label>Range</label>
    	<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|range}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|range}}|{{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|range|max}}||-> {{formatnum: {{#invoke:FanmadeUnitData|get|upgrade|range|max}} }}}}|[[Category:FanmadeUnitData error]]}}</default>
	</data>
  </group>
  <group>
    <header>About</header>
    <data source="release">
    	<label>Release</label>
	</data>
  </group>
</infobox>

<noinclude>
Example usage:
<pre>
{{Tower Infobox

  | title1=Example

  | image1=Example

  | caption1=Example

  | damage_type=Example

  | deployment_cost=Example
  
  | total_cost=Example

  | upgrade_levels=Example

  | tower_type=Example

  | attack_type=Example

  | damage=Example

  | seconds_per_attack=Example

  | range=Example

}}
</pre>
<templatedata>
{"params":{"title1":{"suggested":true},"image1":{"suggested":true},"caption1":{"suggested":true},"damage_type":{"suggested":true},"deployment_cost":{"suggested":true},"total_cost":{"suggested":true},"upgrade_levels":{"suggested":true},"tower_type":{"suggested":true},"attack_type":{"suggested":true},"damage":{"suggested":true},"seconds_per_attack":{"suggested":true},"range":{"suggested":true}},"sets":[],"maps":{}}
</templatedata>
</noinclude>
